descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S15 Hospital → Nursing Home → Hospital on today's one-patient fixture: each sheet shows only its own context, and nothing is invented for a sparse patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context). (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3; UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given make-session fixture as it is today: one Hospital patient (name, age 72, room, 'Community-acquired pneumonia', nothing else) and one In-Today resident (name, MRN, 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture')

When Open the Hospital sheet and wait for generation, go back, switch to Nursing Home and open its sheet, go back, switch to Hospital and open the sheet again

Then Each sheet holds only its own context's patient, regenerates cleanly after the switch and never shows the other context's patient or a stuck 'Generating'; the sparse handoff invents no history, workup, barrier, result, normal finding or documentation-status narration, and shows no 'undefined' / '?yo' placeholder

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: own patient, '1 patient' / '1 resident' and an enabled Send present; the other context's patient, 'Generating' and the lists in spec (likely inventions for these diagnoses, 3.4 phrases, invented normals and narration) absent (3.3; TC-21 'no data bleeding between contexts'). A hit is quoted as a finding

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
